title: Frontend: Project settings tab — name/type/status edit, danger zone
description: Build the project Settings tab with sections for general settings and a danger zone for deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: General section: edit project name, description, type, status with a Save button
Danger zone: 'Delete Project' button with AlertDialog confirmation

steps.details: Create src/components/project/tabs/ProjectSettingsTab.tsx. Sections: General (form with name, description, type, status), Sharing (SharingPanel component), GitHub (GithubConnectPanel component), Danger Zone.
Pre-fill with current project values. On Save: PATCH /api/projects/:id. Invalidate project query. Show success toast.

Red-bordered Card section. 'Delete Project' button opens AlertDialog: 'This will delete your project. Type the project name to confirm.' Input must match project name before enabling Delete button. On confirm: DELETE /api/projects/:id, navigate to /dashboard.
Change project name — verify saves. Change status to 'on_hold' — verify badge updates. Delete project with correct name confirmation — verify navigates to dashboard.
